capabilities: Analyze syllable counts, meter, and rhyme schemes live as a poem is typed
Search CMUdict for perfect and near rhymes, grouped by syllable count
Look up synonyms, antonyms, and definitions from online dictionaries
Surface rare themed vocabulary and draw random literary words with tags
Check poems against fixed forms such as sonnets, villanelles, and limericks
disambiguation: Not just a notebook for storing poems; its core is live prosody analysis and word lookup.
extras: Downloads CMUdict (~1 MB) and a base vocabulary file on first start; Sonorities sound-pattern analysis is explicitly experimental; the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: Built as an English counterpart to the French plugin Carnet du Poète, written independently rather than translated.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in prosody tools, so poets writing verse have no way to check syllable counts, meter, or rhyme schemes inside the editor.

relations.evidence: Sibling project to the French plugin "Carnet du Poète," built independently for English
An optional Datamuse online lookup (off by default) adds any extra matches
the English Wiktionary page itself (etymology and definitions), used automatically
a link opens the word's RhymeZone page in your browser

summary: Sidebar panel that analyzes English poetry for syllables, meter, and rhyme, and looks up rhymes, synonyms, definitions, and rare vocabulary.
